lead_headline: Restaurant tracker caught 8 new leads over the weekend — Ciao Babe opened at Avanti, Mother Other debuted on Broadway, while Pizzeria Lui and Church & Union both shuttered

restaurant.blurb: 8 new leads since Friday — Ciao Babe (Italian, Avanti), Mother Other (vegan, Baker), Sandomi (Japanese, Edgewater) opened; Pizzeria Lui (10 years), Church & Union, Enzo's on Colfax closed.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today as Monday morning starts quiet. Weekend brought 2 status changes: Honey Elixir Lounge (2636 Walnut) upgraded from delinquent to active, HuHot Mongolian Grill (Northfield) dropped to delinquent. Weekly pace at 152 applications — down 44% from prior week's 274, confirming post-freeze surge has fully unwound. Metro licensing activity now tracking historical baseline.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions yesterday (Instagram dirt bike traffic stop, Facebook Urban Grocer coverage) as Sunday recovers from Saturday's single-mention low. Week closes at 63 mentions across 15 sources, down 21% from prior week's 80 — steepest weekly drop in recent tracking. Instagram leads at 18, Facebook 12, Reddit 9, Denver Post 8, Hoodline 5. Key pickups: Riot House lawsuit dismissal (Hoodline), weed grow closure, Wadsworth development dispute. Daily average 9.0 vs. prior week's 11.4 — the slide accelerates.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −7 since Friday (0 new, 7 canceled) as weekend delivers zero acquisitions for second consecutive day. MTD deepens to −23 (−1.2/day), while 90-day net holds at +84. Past two weeks: 10 new vs. 39 canceled — 3.9:1 churn ratio for −29 net, accelerating from prior fortnight's −10. July's first 20 days yield catastrophic 23 acquisitions against 46 cancellations. Zero-acquisition days now standard. YTD net +203 (+1.0/day) sustained solely by Q1-Q2 momentum, but July's trajectory threatens to erase Q2 entirely if pattern holds through month-end.
